name: Bounded real digital communication or deployment with reconciliation
purpose: Perform one bounded nonfinancial digital communication or deployment to an exact owner-controlled target, suppress duplicates, inspect real after-state, reconcile ambiguity, and compensate or restore safely.

example.verification: compare restored SHA-256 and service receipt

preconditions.statement: Account, service, recipient, and resource identities are canonical and independently resolved before authorization.
A unique effect intent, idempotency key, before-state snapshot, and executable compensation plan exist.
The effect is digital and every financial effect class is deterministically denied before execution.

success_criteria.statement: Authorization remains bound to the exact owner-controlled account, service, recipient or resource, payload hash, and idempotency key.
At most one external effect occurs and a retry first inspects provider or system state instead of blindly repeating it.
A real system reference and independently inspected after-state prove the intended bytes or message reached the canonical target.
Partial, wrong, or unverified effect state is compensated or restored and the resulting after-state is independently verified.

unacceptable_outcomes.statement: The recipient, account, repository, service, or resource is substituted after authorization.
A duplicate communication or deployment occurs, or success is claimed without a reconciled after-state receipt.
The proposed or attempted effect purchases, pays, trades, banks, transfers cryptocurrency, changes a financial account, or moves money.

intervention_rules.trigger: Target identity differs between intent, capability, execution, or receipt
intervention_rules.response: Refuse or suspend the effect and reconcile whether any mutation occurred

intervention_rules.trigger: The owner-controlled external system or credential is unavailable
intervention_rules.response: Keep the intent resumable and continue unrelated nonexternal work

intervention_rules.trigger: Authenticated STOP arrives while effect outcome is ambiguous
intervention_rules.response: Freeze retries, inspect current state, and compensate only from verified evidence

failure_injections.inject: Lose the adapter response after the external system accepts the effect
failure_injections.expected_response: Recovery inspects by idempotency key and records one receipt without replay

failure_injections.inject: Substitute a different account or deployment slot after authorization
failure_injections.expected_response: Canonical target mismatch refuses execution before any effect

failure_injections.inject: Make compensation return success while the prior bytes are not restored
failure_injections.expected_response: After-state verification marks compensation failed and prevents PASS

failure_injections.inject: Propose a payment or cryptocurrency transfer using otherwise valid fields
failure_injections.expected_response: Deterministic financial policy denies the intent before capability issue

requirements: Inspect the canonical system by intent and idempotency key before every retry
Classify outcome as absent, completed, partial, or ambiguous from real after-state
Retry only when evidence proves the prior effect did not occur
Execute the frozen compensation plan against the exact canonical target
Inspect and hash the compensated after-state rather than trusting a command exit code
Preserve intent, attempts, receipts, reconciliation, and compensation history
rollback.restoration_target: verified pre-effect state of the owner-controlled deployment slot
